votes.cast.guard: Pick Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday or Sunday.
votes.cast.statement: INSERT INTO votes(choice, created_at) SELECT ?1, ?2 WHERE ?1 IN ('Tuesday','Thursday','Saturday','Sunday')

votes.results.statement: SELECT choice, count(*) AS n FROM votes GROUP BY choice ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 20

votes.perhour.statement: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H', created_at / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS hour, count(*) AS n FROM votes GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour DESC LIMIT 24
